versos.grego: Εἴ τις οὖν παράκλησις ἐν Χριστῷ, εἴ τι παραμύθιον ἀγάπης, εἴ τις κοινωνία Πνεύματος, εἴ τις σπλάγχνα καὶ οἰκτιρμοί,

controles.web: If there is therefore any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,
controles.kjv: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,
controles.livre: Portanto, se há alguma consolação em Cristo, se há algum conforto de amor, se há alguma comunhão do Espírito, se há afetos e compaixões,

versos.grego: πληρώσατέ μου τὴν χαρὰν ἵνα τὸ αὐτὸ φρονῆτε, τὴν αὐτὴν ἀγάπην ἔχοντες, σύνψυχοι, τὸ ἓν φρονοῦντες,

controles.web: make my joy full, by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
controles.kjv: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.
controles.livre: completai a minha alegria: que penseis da mesma maneira, tenhais o mesmo amor, sejais unidos de ânimo, tendo um mesmo modo de pensar.

versos.grego: μηδὲν κατ’ ἐριθείαν μηδὲ κατὰ κενοδοξίαν, ἀλλὰ τῇ ταπεινοφροσύνῃ ἀλλήλους ἡγούμενοι ὑπερέχοντας ἑαυτῶν,

controles.web: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
controles.kjv: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
controles.livre: Nada façais por rivalidade egoísta nem por vanglória; ao contrário, por humildade cada um considere o outro superior a si mesmo.

versos.grego: μὴ τὰ ἑαυτῶν ἕκαστοι σκοποῦντες, ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰ ἑτέρων ἕκαστοι.

controles.web: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
controles.kjv: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
controles.livre: Cada um não cuide somente do que é seu; mas cada um cuide também do que é dos outros.

versos.grego: τοῦτο φρονεῖτε ἐν ὑμῖν ὃ καὶ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,

controles.web: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
controles.kjv: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
controles.livre: Isto seja, para que esteja em vós este modo de pensar, que também esteve em Cristo Jesus:

versos.grego: ὃς ἐν μορφῇ Θεοῦ ὑπάρχων οὐχ ἁρπαγμὸν ἡγήσατο τὸ εἶναι ἴσα Θεῷ,

controles.web: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,
controles.kjv: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
controles.livre: mesmo ele sendo em forma de Deus, não considerou a igualdade a Deus como algo para se obter vantagem;

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ ἑαυτὸν ἐκένωσεν μορφὴν δούλου λαβών, ἐν ὁμοιώματι ἀνθρώπων γενόμενος· καὶ σχήματι εὑρεθεὶς ὡς ἄνθρωπος

controles.web: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.
controles.kjv: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
controles.livre: Ao contrário, ele esvaziou a si mesmo, tomando a forma de servo, e se tornou semelhante aos homens;

versos.grego: ἐταπείνωσεν ἑαυτὸν γενόμενος ὑπήκοος μέχρι θανάτου, θανάτου δὲ σταυροῦ.

controles.web: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to death, yes, the death of the cross.
controles.kjv: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
controles.livre: e, quando se encontrava em forma humana, ele humilhou a si mesmo, sendo obediente até a morte, e morte de cruz.

versos.grego: διὸ καὶ ὁ Θεὸς αὐτὸν ὑπερύψωσεν, καὶ ἐχαρίσατο αὐτῷ τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ὑπὲρ πᾶν ὄνομα,

controles.web: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name;
controles.kjv: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
controles.livre: Por isso Deus também o exaltou supremamente, e lhe deu o nome que é acima de todo nome;

versos.grego: ἵνα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ πᾶν γόνυ κάμψῃ ἐπουρανίων καὶ ἐπιγείων καὶ καταχθονίων,

controles.web: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
controles.kjv: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;
controles.livre: a fim de que no nome de Jesus se dobre todo joelho dos que estão nos céus, na terra, e debaixo da terra,

versos.grego: καὶ πᾶσα γλῶσσα ἐξομολογήσηται ὅτι ΚΥΡΙΟΣ ΙΗΣΟΥΣ ΧΡΙΣΤΟΣ εἰς δόξαν Θεοῦ Πατρός.

controles.web: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
controles.kjv: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
controles.livre: e toda língua confesse que Jesus Cristo é o Senhor, para a glória de Deus Pai.

versos.grego: Ὥστε, ἀγαπητοί μου, καθὼς πάντοτε ὑπηκούσατε, μὴ ὡς ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ μου μόνον ἀλλὰ νῦν πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἐν τῇ ἀπουσίᾳ μου, μετὰ φόβου καὶ τρόμου τὴν ἑαυτῶν σωτηρίαν κατεργάζεσθε·

controles.web: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
controles.kjv: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
controles.livre: Portanto, meus amados, assim como sempre obedecestes, não somente na minha presença, mas muito mais agora em minha ausência, assim exercei a vossa salvação com temor e tremor;

versos.grego: Θεὸς γάρ ἐστιν ὁ ἐνεργῶν ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ τὸ θέλειν καὶ τὸ ἐνεργεῖν ὑπὲρ τῆς εὐδοκίας.

controles.web: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.
controles.kjv: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
controles.livre: pois é Deus quem opera em vós tanto o querer como o agir, conforme a sua boa vontade.

versos.grego: πάντα ποιεῖτε χωρὶς γογγυσμῶν καὶ διαλογισμῶν,

controles.web: Do all things without murmurings and disputes,
controles.kjv: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
controles.livre: Fazei tudo sem murmurações nem brigas,

versos.grego: ἵνα γένησθε ἄμεμπτοι καὶ ἀκέραιοι, τέκνα Θεοῦ ἄμωμα μέσον γενεᾶς σκολιᾶς καὶ διεστραμμένης, ἐν οἷς φαίνεσθε ὡς φωστῆρες ἐν κόσμῳ,

controles.web: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,
controles.kjv: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
controles.livre: para que sejais irrepreensíveis e puros, filhos de Deus, inculpáveis no meio de uma geração corrupta e perversa, na qual brilhais como luminárias no mundo;

versos.grego: λόγον ζωῆς ἐπέχοντες, εἰς καύχημα ἐμοὶ εἰς ἡμέραν Χριστοῦ, ὅτι οὐκ εἰς κενὸν ἔδραμον οὐδὲ εἰς κενὸν ἐκοπίασα.

controles.web: holding up the word of life; that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ, that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.
controles.kjv: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
controles.livre: e mantende a palavra da vida, para que no dia de Cristo eu possa me orgulhar de que não tenho corrido nem trabalhado em vão.

versos.grego: Ἀλλὰ εἰ καὶ σπένδομαι ἐπὶ τῇ θυσίᾳ καὶ λειτουργίᾳ τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν, χαίρω καὶ συνχαίρω πᾶσιν ὑμῖν·

controles.web: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice, and rejoice with you all.
controles.kjv: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.
controles.livre: Mesmo se eu for derramado como oferta sobre o sacrifício e serviço vossa fé, alegro-me e contento-me com todos vós;

versos.grego: τὸ δὲ αὐτὸ καὶ ὑμεῖς χαίρετε καὶ συνχαίρετέ μοι.

controles.web: In the same way, you also rejoice, and rejoice with me.
controles.kjv: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.
controles.livre: e, pelo mesmo motivo, alegrai-vos e contentai-vos comigo.

versos.grego: Ἐλπίζω δὲ ἐν Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Τιμόθεον ταχέως πέμψαι ὑμῖν, ἵνα κἀγὼ εὐψυχῶ γνοὺς τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν.

controles.web: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.
controles.kjv: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
controles.livre: Tenho esperança no Senhor Jesus de em breve vos enviar Timóteo, para que também eu me anime quando souber notícias de vós.

versos.grego: οὐδένα γὰρ ἔχω ἰσόψυχον, ὅστις γνησίως τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν μεριμνήσει·

controles.web: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.
controles.kjv: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
controles.livre: Pois não tenho ninguém de mesmo ânimo que se importe sinceramente convosco,

versos.grego: οἱ πάντες γὰρ τὰ ἑαυτῶν ζητοῦσιν, οὐ τὰ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ’s.
controles.livre: pois todos buscam as suas próprias coisas, e não as de Cristo Jesus.

versos.grego: τὴν δὲ δοκιμὴν αὐτοῦ γινώσκετε, ὅτι ὡς πατρὶ τέκνον σὺν ἐμοὶ ἐδούλευσεν εἰς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον.

controles.web: But you know the proof of him, that, as a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.
controles.kjv: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.
controles.livre: Mas vós sabeis a prova que ele passou,  porque serviu comigo no Evangelho como um filho ao pai.

versos.grego: Τοῦτον μὲν οὖν ἐλπίζω πέμψαι ὡς ἂν ἀφίδω τὰ περὶ ἐμὲ ἐξαυτῆς·

controles.web: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.
controles.kjv: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
controles.livre: Assim, pois, espero enviá-lo, tão logo eu veja o que há de haver comigo.

versos.grego: πέποιθα δὲ ἐν Κυρίῳ ὅτι καὶ αὐτὸς ταχέως ἐλεύσομαι.

controles.web: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.
controles.kjv: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.
controles.livre: Mas confio no Senhor de que também eu mesmo virei em breve.

versos.grego: ἀναγκαῖον δὲ ἡγησάμην Ἐπαφρόδιτον τὸν ἀδελφὸν καὶ συνεργὸν καὶ συνστρατιώτην μου, ὑμῶν δὲ ἀπόστολον καὶ λειτουργὸν τῆς χρείας μου, πέμψαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς,

controles.web: But I counted it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need;
controles.kjv: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
controles.livre: Julguei necessário, porém, enviar-vos Epafrodito, meu irmão, cooperador, e companheiro de batalha, mensageiro enviado por vós, e auxiliador naquilo que necessito;

versos.grego: ἐπειδὴ ἐπιποθῶν ἦν πάντας ὑμᾶς, καὶ ἀδημονῶν, διότι ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἠσθένησεν.

controles.web: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled, because you had heard that he was sick.
controles.kjv: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.
controles.livre: porque ele tinha muitas saudades de todos vós, e estava muito angustiado por haverdes ouvido de que ele havia ficado doente.

versos.grego: καὶ γὰρ ἠσθένησεν παραπλήσιον θανάτῳ· ἀλλὰ ὁ Θεὸς ἠλέησεν αὐτόν, οὐκ αὐτὸν δὲ μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐμέ, ἵνα μὴ λύπην ἐπὶ λύπην σχῶ.

controles.web: For indeed he was sick, nearly to death, but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.
controles.kjv: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
controles.livre: E ele ficou mesmo doente, quase a morrer; mas o Deus dele teve misericórdia, não somente dele, mas também de mim, para que eu não tivesse tristeza após tristeza.

versos.grego: σπουδαιοτέρως οὖν ἔπεμψα αὐτὸν, ἵνα ἰδόντες αὐτὸν πάλιν χαρῆτε κἀγὼ ἀλυπότερος ὦ.

controles.web: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that, when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
controles.kjv: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
controles.livre: Por isso eu o enviei mais depressa, a fim de que, vendo-o de novo, alegrei-vos e eu fique menos triste.

versos.grego: προσδέχεσθε οὖν αὐτὸν ἐν Κυρίῳ μετὰ πάσης χαρᾶς, καὶ τοὺς τοιούτους ἐντίμους ἔχετε,

controles.web: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such in honor,
controles.kjv: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
controles.livre: Recebei-o, pois, no Senhor, com toda alegria; e honrai ao que são como ele;

versos.grego: ὅτι διὰ τὸ ἔργον Χριστοῦ μέχρι θανάτου ἤγγισεν παραβολευσάμενος τῇ ψυχῇ, ἵνα ἀναπληρώσῃ τὸ ὑμῶν ὑστέρημα τῆς πρός με λειτουργίας.

controles.web: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
controles.kjv: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
controles.livre: pois, por causa da obra de Cristo, ele chegou perto da morte, arriscando a sua própria vida para suprir em meu benefício a falta do vosso serviço.
